## Select genomes

Choose two different GenBank assemblies from [NCBI Datasets](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/genome/?taxon=80865). The comparison updates when either selection changes. Assemblies can represent different versions of the same strain.

```{=html}
<div id="genome-selectors" class="dashboard-controls genome-selectors" hidden>
  <label for="genome-first">First genome
    <select id="genome-first" aria-controls="selected-genome-comparison"></select>
  </label>
  <label for="genome-second">Second genome
    <select id="genome-second" aria-controls="selected-genome-comparison"></select>
  </label>
</div>
<p id="genome-selection-status" role="status">Interactive selection requires JavaScript and access to NCBI. The published example below is available without either.</p>
<button id="genome-selection-retry" class="btn btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Retry loading genomes</button>
<div id="selected-genome-comparison" class="genome-comparison-table-wrap" role="region" aria-label="Selected genome comparison" tabindex="0" hidden></div>
<script src="genome-comparison.js" defer></script>
```

These are assembly metadata and summary statistics, not a sequence alignment, average nucleotide identity (ANI) analysis, or a standardized reannotation. Missing values are shown as “Not reported”; differences do not establish species-wide traits.

## Published example: MTQ3 and HA60

The table summarizes features reported in the genome announcements for strains MTQ3 and HA60. Both are *D. tsuruhatensis*, not representatives of every strain in the species.

::: {#genome-comparison-table .genome-comparison-table-wrap role="region" aria-label="Genome feature comparison" tabindex="0"}

| Feature | MTQ3 | HA60 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Genome status | Draft genome | Complete genome; circular chromosome |
| Genome length | 6.27 Mb | 6,922,195 bp (about 6.92 Mb) |
| G+C content | 66.79% | 66.45% |
| Isolation context | Tobacco rhizosphere | Commercial nano-hydroxyapatite product |
| Published focus | Described in its genome announcement as a plant growth-promoting rhizobacterium | Genome sequence report for a strain isolated from a nano-hydroxyapatite product |

:::

## Sources

- Draft Genome Sequence of *Delftia tsuruhatensis* MTQ3, a Strain of Plant Growth-Promoting Rhizobacterium Isolated from Tobacco Rhizosphere (2015). [Read the PubMed record](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26251486/).
- Complete genome sequence of *Delftia tsuruhatensis* strain HA60 isolated from a commercial nano-hydroxyapatite product (2024). [Find the article on PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=10.1128%2Fmra.00171-24) · [Read the full text in PubMed Central](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11237730/) · [DOI: 10.1128/mra.00171-24](https://doi.org/10.1128/mra.00171-24).

Genome sizes, G+C percentages, assembly status, isolation contexts, and descriptions above are reported by the cited articles. They come from separate sequencing and annotation studies and are not a standardized reanalysis; differences should not be interpreted as species-wide traits.
